Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Class SceneEntity.Builder

java.lang.Object
ke.ric.renderer.api.SceneEntity.Builder
Enclosing class:
SceneEntity
public static final class SceneEntity.Builder extends Object
Mutable builder for immutable entity evidence; do not share it concurrently. Defaults to origin, zero yaw, unit bounds, living/adult, cube size 1, air equipment and a UUID-derived nonzero ID. Callers still supply complete resolved targets when the scene requires entity visuals.
